cues: Opens with "Now I have the reference materials... I'll follow all 10 steps carefully," explicitly stating it is following a multi-step methodology
Rigid numbered template sections (classification/constraints, dependencies, key decisions, Phase 0 slice, phases, validation checks, cross-cutting, AI layer, exceptions, deferred)
Methodology-specific jargon and labels: reversibility tiers R1/R2/R3, ASSUMPTION/UNKNOWN labels, gated V0–V4 validation IDs with pass bars, 'Phase 0 first end-to-end slice'
Dedicated 'AI layer (AI/agentic systems only)' table with nine sublayers plus 'Exceptions: None' and 'Deferred' with flip triggers, which looks like template-mandated sections
Every phase has rollback and exit-check entries, and a per-phase cross-cutting matrix (security/observability/reproducibility/resilience), which indicates a prescribed structure
